source.clock: video playback seconds, not the run timer
source.method: Curated from the existing visual-review notes; not a new continuous video transcription.

assumptions: No vitamins, PokeRus, Macho Brace, or shared participation.
Attack IV25 is the overlay value; gameplay stat readings also permit24. Alternative raw stats are retained.
Bag starts empty; the early empty ITEMS pocket supports the new-game state.
Only recorded acquisitions/uses occur; observations are checked rather than used to silently reset quantities.
No PP Ups are used; PP maxima are base Gen3 values, checked against recorded move menus.
Battle ending HP is observed/carried forward, not calculated from damage by this ledger.
